messages:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert fired for inference-gateway: error_rate_http_5xx > 3% (5m) in prod-us-west2. Incident: PD-INC-9102. Autopage: true. Escalation: page. Links: https://pagerduty.example/PD-INC-9102 | Runbook: https://confluence.example/runbooks/inference-gateway
marie (oncall): acking — taking this. I'll start by checking graphs and any ongoing customer reports.
PagerDuty: PD-INC-9102 acknowledged by marie (oncall).
ajay: seeing 504/502s from edge-proxy pods. spike started ~2m ago. traces show upstream timeouts `upstream timed out` and `connection reset by peer`.
lena: checking k8s: a few proxy pods have high restart_count and socket backlog. looking into node metrics and recent deploys.
marie (oncall): @support-team any incoming tickets or large customers affected?
support-team: one ticket from acme-corp complaining about timeouts in the chat feature, started ~3m ago. low volume so far.
ajay: tailing proxy logs: repeating pattern — backend model host returns 504 after 30s. sample: `2026-03-15T02:14:32Z ERR upstream timeout id=xyz host=model-ocelot-2`
marie (oncall): can we put a small percentage of traffic to fallback region (us-east1) to reduce customer impact while we triage?
lena: initiating canary reroute: POST /routing/v1/shift — body `{ "service": "inference-gateway", "percent": 10, "to": "us-east1" }` (exec by lena)
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook step 3 executed by lena: warmed cache on fallback, primed KV cache ~120k keys, warmed embeddings layer.
ajay: also seeing duplicate PagerDuty pages — even though PD-INC-9102 was acked, autopager fired again. looks like alert dedup window is shorter than rule evaluation window.
marie (oncall): that's noisy. I'm going to silence autopage for this incident for 15m while we stabilize: `/pd silence PD-INC-9102 15m`
PagerDuty: Silence applied to PD-INC-9102 by marie (oncall) — 15m.
lena: canary at 10% to us-east1 is live. error rate there is ~0.6% vs 8% on prod-us-west2. traffic is healthy so far.
ajay: doing rolling restart of edge-proxy pods to clear conn state; restarted 4/6 so far. one node still shows high socket backlog — cordoning it: `kubectl cordon node-abc123`
marie (oncall): also lowering edge concurrency for the route to force graceful backpressure: `POST /admin/configs/edge?route=/v1/complete -d '{"max_concurrency": 0.8}'`
ajay: backend model host team reports a GC pause spike on model-ocelot-2 around the time the errors started. investigating whether it's a resource regen bug.
marie (oncall): customer impact summary: a subset of requests hitting the long-tail model route experienced 5xxs up to ~20% for approximately 6 minutes before traffic shift and restarts reduced errors. Impact limited to some real-time features (chat completions). Not a full outage.
lena: saving perf graphs, logs, and sample traces to the incident doc. tagging for postmortem.
marie (oncall): creating short incident note and P0->P1 notification to Growth & Status: /status create "Partial degradation: inference 5xx spike in us-west2, mitigated via fallback and restarts"
IncidentBot: Incident PD-INC-9102 status: mitigated. last_event: 75s ago. Autopage suppressed for 15m.
marie (oncall): next steps: trigger post-incident with root-cause (GC spike + misaligned alert dedup causing noise). Assign to ajay/lena for follow-up. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
